page_title: FRO 1-2 JUV | Frosinone v Juventus 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Maurizio Mariani is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' The goal by Juventus won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The Juventus players halt their celebrations as referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
89' Juventus are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
85' The ratio of the ball possession is 57:43.
81' 1 - 2 Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets on the end of a fine cross and heads the ball into the top left corner!
79' Substitution. Jaime Baez Stabile makes way for Giorgi Kvernadze (Frosinone).
77' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) picks up an injury.
73' The ball is out of play and Frosinone manage to earn a corner.
72' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Wojciech Szczesny thwarts him with a nice save. Frosinone win a corner.
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Luca Garritano as he is replaced by Abdou Harroui (Frosinone).
69' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Kaio Jorge and he is replaced by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone).
69' Here comes a substitution. Timothy Weah (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Andrea Cambiaso.
68' A cross from a corner kick by Frosinone is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
68' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:2.
66' The ball goes out for a corner. Juventus can continue in their attacking effort.
64' The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
64' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Stefano Turati.
63' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes.
59' Frosinone force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
58' That was close. Matias Soule (Frosinone) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
57' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Juventus.
56' It will be a corner kick for Juventus.
55' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Kenan Yildiz will be replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
54' We are about to witness a substitution. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) is replacing Manuel Locatelli.
54' Substitution. Filip Kostic will be replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
53' Looks like Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
51' 1 - 1 Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
51' The Frosinone players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
47' Neat passing move from Frosinone in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Filip Kostic (Juventus) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

45+3' Filip Kostic (Juventus) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
43' Weston McKennie (Juventus) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
43' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
42' The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.

39' Ambitious effort from Filip Kostic (Juventus). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
38' The corner is swung in but Frosinone can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
38' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone). The linesman makes the right call and Frosinone will have a corner.
36' A pass from Matias Soule (Frosinone) is intercepted by Wojciech Szczesny and the move breaks down.
34' Danilo (Juventus) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
34' Filip Kostic (Juventus) is about to take a corner kick.
33' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
33' The ball goes behind for a corner. Frosinone will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) is coming onto the pitch as Pol Lirola cannot continue after picking up an injury.
30' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
28' Filip Kostic (Juventus) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
27' Massimiliano Allegri is forced to make a change. Alex Sandro is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Federico Gatti (Juventus).
26' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
26' Alex Sandro (Juventus) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' The Frosinone players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

22' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) executes a nice mid-range free kick. His effort only flies inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.

21' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Frosinone, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
20' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
20' 54:46 – the ratio of ball possession.
16' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sprays a pass out to Filip Kostic, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
14' A cross into the box from Filip Kostic (Juventus) is cleared.

12' 0 - 1 Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Stefano Turati is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
11' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
8' Weston McKennie (Juventus) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
7' Filip Kostic (Juventus) steps up to send the ball in.
7' Weston McKennie (Juventus) passes the ball onto Arkadiusz Milik, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
6' Great teamplay by Frosinone as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Frosinone will take the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani is the one to supervise the game today.
